wiki.title: Rob Hutton
wiki.extract: Robert Brian Hutton (born April 7, 1967) is an American businessman and Republican politician from Waukesha County, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 5th Senate district since January 2023. He previously served in the Wisconsin State Assembly from 2013 through 2020, and was a member of the Waukesha County board of supervisors from 2005 to 2012.
